summary: Iteration-11: Verified outbound-template greeting-placeholder bug fix. New file test_vozlead_iter11.py (7/7 pass). Checks: admin templates no longer mention 'Clínica' and contain {agente}/{empresa}; new tenant gets default greeting using placeholders (not hard-coded business_name); vapi.greeting() + vapi.build_assistant() with agent Marta/OpenFactura.es renders 'Hola Juan, soy Marta, asistente virtual de OpenFactura.es...' as firstMessage and system_prompt mentions OpenFactura.es (not Clínica); inbound greeting still 'Hola, OpenFactura.es, te atiende Marta...'; scheduled-call endpoint persists template.greeting with placeholders (no real call placed, future run_at then cancelled); seed.migrate_templates rewrites legacy clinic greeting. Frontend /app/llamadas verified: template-greeting-hint testid present with text 'Usa {nombre} (cliente), {agente} y {empresa}: se rellenan con el nombre y la empresa del agente que hace la llamada.'; default greeting textarea pre-filled with new placeholder-based text; existing templates list has no 'Clínica' mentions.
critical_code_review_comments: saas.py v1_create_call still builds its greeting via f-string with the business_name interpolated (line ~455): 'Hola {{nombre}}, soy {agent[name]}, asistente virtual de {biz}'. This is correct for the public API path (uses the agent that is making the call), but note the design asymmetry vs. templates: templates store placeholders and resolve at call time, while v1 bakes the business_name at creation time. If a tenant renames their business_name between v1_create_call and dispatch_due picking up the scheduled call, the baked greeting will be stale. Low priority (API consumers rarely rename).

seed.migrate_templates regex only matches the specific legacy pattern 'Hola {nombre}, (soy {agente}, )?te llamo de .+\. Soy una? asistente virtual y la llamada se graba\.'. Any other legacy variant (e.g., templates edited manually by users or earlier seed variants) will NOT be migrated. Safe for the known Clínica Dental seed; main agent should confirm there are no other legacy wordings in prod.

seed.seed() still creates the sample agent with business_name='Clínica Dental Sonrisa' and the sample lead-transcript hard-codes 'Marta, la asistente virtual de Clínica Dental Sonrisa'. This is the admin demo tenant only — expected per iter-10 — but the user reported seeing the clinic greeting from their outbound agent. Confirm with user that their outbound agent's own `greeting` field (agents collection) was also updated — just migrating templates is not enough if the agent doc itself still has clinic text. Recommend adding an agent-level migration too, or at least documenting that users must edit their agent greeting.
scheduled_calls stores a snapshot of tpl.greeting at schedule time; the resolution happens inside vapi.greeting() when dispatch runs — correct, because at that point `agent` is loaded fresh. Good.

TemplateEditor default greeting is hardcoded in Outbound.jsx (frontend) matching backend TEMPLATE_GREETING constant — if backend constant changes, frontend must be updated in lock-step. Consider fetching the default from backend or sharing a constant.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run iter-11: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_vozlead_iter11.py -v`. Uses pattern of loading REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env and MONGO_URL from /app/backend/.env (stripping surrounding quotes). The register endpoint returns the user object fields merged with 'access_token' at the top level — no nested 'user' key. AgentIn requires 'ambience' and 'ambience_volume' (not optional). seed.migrate_templates regex is narrow — only matches the Clínica Dental legacy wording; be aware when adding more migrations. The admin tenant's business_name is still 'Clínica Dental Sonrisa' (seed) — that is expected and not the bug; the bug was that templates' greetings baked that name instead of using placeholders.
rca of the issue: Root cause confirmed: pre-fix TEMPLATE_GREETING in saas.list_templates auto-created call_templates with the account's business_name hard-coded in the greeting. Fix path: (1) TEMPLATE_GREETING constant now uses {nombre}/{agente}/{empresa}; (2) startup seed.migrate_templates rewrites existing default clinic greetings via regex; (3) vapi.greeting() resolves {empresa}/{agente}/{nombre} using the agent making the call, so when a user later renames their business or has multiple agents the correct name is used; (4) frontend TemplateEditor hints users about the placeholders. Reproduction: before fix, admin's templates all read '…te llamo de Clínica Dental Sonrisa…'; after fix, admin's templates read '…asistente virtual de {empresa}…' and vapi.build_assistant renders 'OpenFactura.es' when the calling agent belongs to that business. Mitigation delivered.
